subtitle: Khanyisa amaseli avulekile
short_description: Beka amalambu ukuze wonke amaseli avulekile akhanye ngaphandle kokubonana.
description:
Beka amalambu egridini le-4×4 ukuze wonke amaseli avulekile akhanyiswe, akukho malambu amabili akhanyisana, futhi lowo nalowo udonga olunenombolo uthinta amalambu ngokuphelele njengalenombolo.

Thepha iseli elivulekile ukuze ujikeleze phakathi kwelambu, isikhumbuzo sokungabi ilambu, nelingenalutho. Amaseli akhanyisiwe aqaqambisa njengoba uqhubeka.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
